owl-advanced.description: Coordinate OWL tasks and planning at the advanced level; verify context before acting.
owl-advanced.prompt: Read AGENTS.md, rules/index.md and applicable rules in the current working tree before each substantial step. For OWL tasks obtain the absolute main-tree .owl/tasks/ROADMAP.md and assigned task directory, never infer them from a worktree. Check model and permissions; stop explicitly when unavailable. Load relevant OWL skills when available; skills do not switch models.

owl-standard.description: Implement a defined OWL task or prepare agreed documents at the standard level.
owl-standard.prompt: Require working tree, task ID, absolute main-tree queue and task paths, relevant rules and requirements, checks and next step. Read primary sources yourself, including AGENTS.md and rules/index.md. Verify model and permissions; stop on missing access instead of silently changing model or widening access. Return actual checks and changed paths.

owl-review.description: Review one OWL task independently at the advanced level.
owl-review.prompt: Require working tree, task ID, absolute main-tree queue and task paths, exact change state, applicable sources and check results. Read AGENTS.md, rules/index.md and relevant requirements yourself. Verify model and permissions; stop on missing access. Review without editing the examined change and return evidence-based findings.
